name: The Frozen Kingdom
source:
Hundreds of years ago, humans and elves came together to defeat the evil sorceress whose magic had plunged the world into an endless winter. Unbeknownst to them, said sorceress had a son, Oggun, and he’s been bidding his time ever since, waiting for the opportunity to take her place to arise.

Our protagonist, Einar, becomes the last descendant of the warrior who slayed the sorceress after Oggun's men destroy his village. Now on a quest for revenge, Einar finds himself joining forces with an elven nobleman and a merchant friend of his that, by matter of fate, both happened to be at the village at the time.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856210/]Steam[/url]]
